name: Potluck Chicken & Potato Soup
text:
INGREDIENTS
4 lb chicken tenderloins
3 lb skin-on potatoes, diced
4 medium onions (about 1 1/2 lb), chopped
3/4 lb carrots, sliced
3/4 lb celery, chopped
2 oz garlic, minced
12 cups chicken bouillon
1½ tbsp oil
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1½ tsp thyme
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp liquid smoke
2 (12 fl oz) cans evaporated milk

CHICKEN MARINADE
2 tsp garlic powder
2 tsp onion powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt
1½ tbsp Lea & Perrins Worcestershire Sauce
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar

DIRECTIONS
1. Cut the chicken tenderloins into bite-size pieces.
2. Toss the chicken with the garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, salt, Lea & Perrins Worcestershire Sauce, and apple cider vinegar until evenly coated. Let rest 20–30 minutes.
3. Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the chicken and sauté 4–5 minutes, stirring frequently, until cooked through. Remove the chicken and its juices and set aside.
4. Add the onions, carrots, and celery to the same skillet. Cook 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Add the garlic, smoked paprika, thyme, and black pepper. Cook for about 30 seconds.
6. Transfer the vegetables to the soup pot. Add the chicken bouillon, potatoes, and liquid smoke. Simmer 15–20 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
7. Mash some of the potatoes against the side of the pot to thicken the broth.
8. Reduce the heat to low. Stir in the evaporated milk and heat gently. Avoid a hard boil.
9. Return the cooked chicken and its juices to the soup 3–4 minutes before serving, just long enough to heat through.
10. Taste and adjust the salt if needed.

NOTES
Saved October 26, 2026.
Yield: approximately 210 oz (about 13.1 × 16-oz servings).

MACROS
Whole pot at 1x: 4,474 calories · 490 g protein · 438.2 g carbs · 88.9 g fat · 52.6 g fiber
